resolved_review_items.reason: FC controls whose second parameter is 3C occupy five bytes, not three. The extra two operands had been misread as text, including a spurious 01FC glyph. Correct operand lengths resolve both anomalies without inventing a glyph.

native_text_renderer.FC_parameters: Reads two following bytes; an FF parameter is obtained from the input-byte helper instead
native_text_renderer.FC_nested_reference: When the second parameter is below 13, saves a return pointer on an eight-entry stack and follows a relative text-table reference

native_text_renderer.caution: Do not normalize inline control operands into visible Latin text. FC 3C extra operands may include FE or FF, which are not page/command ends in that position.
native_text_renderer.five_byte_FC_control: FC + parameter1 + 3C + two further operands; formatter file 6bdf0 branches on 3C and copies the extra operand bytes.

reinsertion_research_hypothesis.approach: A compressed member expands into a separate English bank. Its original VM prefix is copied to its original fixed address. The scenario-only formatter hook binary-searches original source offsets, formats English and returns original source consumption. Original next-opcode advancement is exercised independently through native phase instructions.
rejected_shortcuts: Do not use 8c019088 as a proven loaded D_SCE member base. The executable initializes it to embedded program root data at 8c01908c, and native root/call helpers use that table.
Do not treat opcode 8E handler return 0x8000 as a proven scenario allocation size. It is a VM return value; the actual loader/buffer ownership is unproven.
Do not advance the original VM pointer by English consumption. The original command end/length must be retained independently.
